name: Spec ↔ BoQ ↔ drawings
lead: Before the tender set goes out, every specification clause is matched to the bill of quantities and the drawings. Discrepancies are listed with evidence, and your engineer makes the call.

project.title: Larkfield Primary School (fictional): tender documents stage, packages 02 Concrete and 06 Windows

extracts.text: Extension ground-floor roof slab: solid reinforced concrete, 220 mm thick, concrete class C30/37.
Solid reinforced concrete slab 200 mm, C30/37, m2, 640.
Cast-in-place reinforced concrete ground beams under the north elevation, 300 x 500 mm, reinforcement included.
Lines 2.3.1 Strip footings, 2.3.2 Pad footings, 2.3.3 Mass concrete. No ground beam line.
Thermally broken aluminium windows, Uw 1.3 W/m2K or better. Street elevations: sound reduction Rw+Ctr of at least 33 dB.
Boulevard elevation: required facade insulation of at least 35 dB, i.e. windows of at least 36 dB Rw+Ctr.
Aluminium window, street elevation, 33 dB Rw+Ctr, nr, 24.
Aluminium window, courtyard elevation, type C2, nr, 18.
Courtyard elevation: 16 windows of type C2.
All work complies with the 2012 edition of the energy code.
Extension: current energy code edition and net-zero-ready target.
Slab and wall concrete: C30/37, exposure class XC1.

steps: Reading specifications, bills of quantities, drawings and reports
Matching each clause to a BoQ line
Sourced list of discrepancies, for your decision

fields.label: Alert threshold for quantity differences
fields.hint: Quantity differences below this threshold are not flagged

checks.label: Type C2 quantity difference (18 vs 16, i.e. 12.5%) under the threshold

output.title: Discrepancy sheet to clear before issuing tender documents
output.sub: Each item shows both documents involved, with the page. Nothing is corrected automatically.

items.t: Ground-floor roof slab: 220 mm (specification) or 200 mm (drawings and BoQ)? Confirm with the structural calculation before aligning the documents.
North elevation ground beams: add a BoQ line in section 2.3, or delete clause 3.7.3 if the element was dropped.
Street-side windows: raise the requirement to 36 dB Rw+Ctr in specification 06 and BoQ line 6.1.2, per the acoustic report.
Code reference: replace the 2012 energy code edition with the current edition in clause 1.6 of specification 02.
Concrete class C30/37: identical in the specification, the BoQ and the structural drawings.

contradictions.title: Ground-floor roof slab thickness
contradictions.impact: Concrete and rebar quantities, and the structural calculation.
contradictions.action: Settle the thickness with the calculation, then align the specification or the drawings.

contradictions.title: Specified but not priced: north elevation ground beams
contradictions.impact: Missing from pricing, so a likely claim or change order during construction.
contradictions.action: Add the BoQ line or delete the clause.

contradictions.title: Acoustic performance of street-side windows
contradictions.impact: Facade insulation missed at handover, with costly remedial work.
contradictions.action: Raise the requirement to 36 dB in the specification and the BoQ.

contradictions.title: Quantity of type C2 courtyard windows
contradictions.action: Recount on the drawing and correct the BoQ.

contradictions.title: Superseded code reference
contradictions.impact: A contract document pointing to a superseded standard.

value.case: packages 02 and 06: 2 specifications (52 pages), 2 bills of quantities (210 lines), structural and architectural drawings rev. C, 1 acoustic report.
